printTemplate.staticValueWins: The typed value overrides the binding
printTemplate.barcodeHint.code128: Any ASCII: document number, order code. Digit runs are compressed automatically.
printTemplate.barcodeHint.ean13: 12 or 13 digits. The check digit is computed; if given, it is verified.
printTemplate.barcodeHint.qr: Any text, Cyrillic included. The code is square — it takes the smaller side of the frame.
printTemplate.textOrientationHint: The line runs bottom to top and wraps by the HEIGHT of the frame. With no height set the text runs as one line of its full length.
printTemplate.cellOrientationHint: A rotated caption does not wrap: its length becomes the row height. Alignment runs bottom to top.
printTemplate.charCellsHint: Take the number of cells from the approved form: tax number — 12, personal number — 10, date — 8. The value is sliced exactly as it arrives: a date for cells must come from the data command without separators. An empty height makes the cell square — set its size through the frame width.
printTemplate.propertiesEmpty: Select a block from the list
printTemplate.placementFlowHint: The block stands under the previous one in the list, wherever it ended — Y does not affect print, it only places the frame on the canvas. «Keep with next» holds this block and the following one on one page.
printTemplate.visibleWhenHiddenNow: With the sample data this element is not printed
printTemplate.columnsHint: Column width: a percentage, `fit` (so the value never wraps) or `auto` (takes the slack). For auto/fit the core computes the width; next to it is the floor in points. A hidden column gives its width to its neighbours.
printTemplate.textStyleOption.title: Title
printTemplate.layoutHint: Drag blocks; arrows nudge, Alt+arrows resize
printTemplate.previewEmpty: Preview appears once the template has blocks
printTemplate.previewTargetRequired: Fill in model and data command
printTemplate.previewPayloadObjectRequir: Payload must be a JSON object
printTemplate.previewDataObjectRequired: Preview data must be a JSON object
printTemplate.previewDataInvalid: Preview data is not valid JSON
printTemplate.importError: Could not read the template file
printTemplate.sectionHint.footer: Printed once, after the last record
printTemplate.cellTextWins: Text, when set, overrides the binding
printTemplate.cellSelectHint: Click selects a cell, Shift+click a range
printTemplate.columnWidth: Width: auto, fit or a percentage
